triggerReasons.message: A milestone ledger exists, so every ledger row needs checklist and verificationIntent coverage.
High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: 固定且可重建的同输入 A/B 样本可重复产生相同核心 digest 和分层 measurement/finding 结果；不可重建或篡改样本只产生稳定 INCONCLUSIVE，实验运行前后生产 evidence digest 相同。
acceptanceBindings.note: One user-visible acceptance claim spans all four ordered milestones; every bound intent requires passing evidence before DONE.

note: Story 3 ProofStory contract binds the original outcome to all four checklist items, all twelve independent verification intents and all four milestones.
